name: Neovim (LazyVim)
description: Installs Neovim (EDITOR=nvim) with a LazyVim config in ~/.config/nvim, plugins installed at build time, plus what LazyVim needs (git, tree-sitter CLI, C compiler).

config.description: Install the bundled LazyVim config to ~/.config/nvim (skipped if that already exists) and its plugins
